verdict.rationale: A documented public API is a fair question for an HR, payroll, and PEO SaaS product, so the axis applies. However, every documentation item describes UI click-paths (Pay > Make a Payment, Time Off > Policies) or a first-party Xero accounting integration, not a public API a user could program against. The /api/v2/help_center URLs belong to the help-center hosting platform, not Justworks' own API. OpenAPI and llms.txt probes on the help domain returned 404.
